form.label: Microsoft Defender XDR Overview
form.description: Fixture-backed onboarding and first-triage view for Microsoft Defender XDR, Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Identity, Defender for Office 365, and Defender for Cloud Apps JSON relay sourcetypes. Synthetic-equivalent fixtures are not replay/read-back validation.

search.query: index=epintel (sourcetype="microsoft:defender:xdr:device_process" OR sourcetype="microsoft:defender:xdr:device_network" OR sourcetype="microsoft:defender:xdr:file_event" OR sourcetype="microsoft:defender:xdr:alert_info" OR sourcetype="microsoft:defender:xdr:alert_evidence" OR sourcetype="microsoft:defender:xdr:identity_logon" OR sourcetype="microsoft:defender:xdr:identity_directory" OR sourcetype="microsoft:defender:xdr:identity_query" OR sourcetype="microsoft:defender:xdr:cloud_app" OR sourcetype="microsoft:defender:xdr:email_event" OR sourcetype="microsoft:defender:xdr:email_url" OR sourcetype="microsoft:defender:xdr:device_registry" OR sourcetype="microsoft:defender:xdr:email_attachment" OR sourcetype="microsoft:defender:xdr:vulnerability") | eval family=coalesce(defender_table, Table, case(sourcetype="microsoft:defender:xdr:device_process","DeviceProcessEvents", sourcetype="microsoft:defender:xdr:device_network","DeviceNetworkEvents", sourcetype="microsoft:defender:xdr:file_event","DeviceFileEvents", sourcetype="microsoft:defender:xdr:alert_info","AlertInfo", sourcetype="microsoft:defender:xdr:alert_evidence","AlertEvidence", sourcetype="microsoft:defender:xdr:identity_logon","IdentityLogonEvents", sourcetype="microsoft:defender:xdr:identity_directory","IdentityDirectoryEvents", sourcetype="microsoft:defender:xdr:identity_query","IdentityQueryEvents", sourcetype="microsoft:defender:xdr:cloud_app","CloudAppEvents", sourcetype="microsoft:defender:xdr:email_event","EmailEvents", sourcetype="microsoft:defender:xdr:email_url","EmailUrlInfo", sourcetype="microsoft:defender:xdr:device_registry","DeviceRegistryEvents", sourcetype="microsoft:defender:xdr:email_attachment","EmailAttachmentInfo", sourcetype="microsoft:defender:xdr:vulnerability","DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities")) | eval device=coalesce(device_name, DeviceName, dest, DestinationDeviceName), actor=coalesce(user, AccountUpn, InitiatingProcessAccountUpn, process_user), target=coalesce(target_user, TargetAccountUpn), alert=coalesce(alert_id, AlertId), risk_severity=coalesce(severity, Severity), action_name=coalesce(action, ActionType, ActivityType), remote=coalesce(dest_ip, RemoteIP, url, RemoteUrl, IPAddress), proc=coalesce(process, FileName, parent_process, InitiatingProcessFileName), proc_cmd=coalesce(process_command_line, ProcessCommandLine, parent_process_command_line, InitiatingProcessCommandLine), file=coalesce(file_name, FileName, ObjectName), folder=coalesce(file_path, FolderPath), app=coalesce(application, Application), query_text=coalesce(query, Query), email_sender=coalesce(sender, SenderFromAddress, SenderMailFromAddress), email_recipient=coalesce(recipient, RecipientEmailAddress), email_subject=coalesce(subject, Subject), email_threat=coalesce(threat_types, ThreatTypes), message_id=coalesce(network_message_id, NetworkMessageId), registry_object=coalesce(registry_key, RegistryKey), registry_value=coalesce(registry_value_name, RegistryValueName), attachment_name=coalesce(file_name, FileName), attachment_type=coalesce(file_type, FileType), cve_id=coalesce(cve, CveId), software=coalesce(software_name, SoftwareName), software_version=coalesce(software_version, SoftwareVersion), recommended_update=coalesce(recommended_security_update, RecommendedSecurityUpdate), marker_value=coalesce(marker, mvindex(spath(_raw,"marker"),0))
| stats count
| search family IN ("AlertInfo","AlertEvidence") | stats count
| search family IN ("DeviceProcessEvents","DeviceNetworkEvents","DeviceFileEvents","DeviceRegistryEvents") | stats count

single.option: Process, network, file, and registry rows

search.query: | search family IN ("IdentityLogonEvents","IdentityDirectoryEvents","IdentityQueryEvents","CloudAppEvents","EmailEvents","EmailUrlInfo","EmailAttachmentInfo") | stats count

single.option: Identity, Cloud Apps, and email rows

search.query: | search family="AlertInfo" risk_severity IN ("Medium","High") | stats count

panel.title: Event volume over time by Defender table

search.query: | timechart span=15m count by family limit=10
| stats count by family | sort - count
| stats count dc(family) as families values(family) as defender_tables values(action_name) as actions values(risk_severity) as severities by device actor | sort - count | head 20
| stats count values(risk_severity) as severities values(family) as defender_tables by action_name | sort - count | head 20
| search family="DeviceProcessEvents" | table _time device actor action_name proc process_command_line parent_process parent_process_command_line file_hash marker_value | sort - _time | head 25
| search family="DeviceNetworkEvents" | table _time device actor action_name proc proc_cmd src_ip src_port dest_ip dest_port transport url marker_value | sort - _time | head 25
| search family="DeviceFileEvents" | table _time device actor action_name file file_path file_hash marker_value | sort - _time | head 25
| search family="AlertInfo" | table _time alert risk_severity category signature service_source detection_source AttackTechniques marker_value | sort - _time | head 25

| search family IN ("IdentityLogonEvents","IdentityDirectoryEvents","IdentityQueryEvents") | table _time family device actor target action_name app LogonType QueryType query_text src_ip dest_port transport AdditionalFields marker_value | sort - _time | head 25
| search family="CloudAppEvents" | table _time actor action_name app ActivityType ObjectType ObjectName src_ip device marker_value | sort - _time | head 25

| search family IN ("EmailEvents","EmailUrlInfo","EmailAttachmentInfo") | table _time family message_id email_sender email_recipient email_subject action_name delivery_location email_threat detection_methods confidence_level url url_domain url_location attachment_name attachment_type file_hash marker_value | sort - _time | head 25

| search family="DeviceRegistryEvents" | table _time device actor action_name registry_object registry_value RegistryValueData parent_process parent_process_command_line marker_value | sort - _time | head 25
| search family="DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities" | table _time device cve_id risk_severity software software_version recommended_update marker_value | sort - _time | head 25
| search family="EmailAttachmentInfo" | table _time message_id attachment_name attachment_type file_hash email_threat detection_methods marker_value | sort - _time | head 25

| search family="AlertEvidence" | stats count values(entity_type) as entity_types values(evidence_role) as evidence_roles values(device) as devices values(actor) as users values(proc) as processes values(folder) as file_paths values(remote) as remote_context values(marker_value) as markers by alert | sort - count | head 25

panel.title: Onboarding coverage by source, host, and sourcetype

search.query: | stats count dc(marker_value) as fixture_markers min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen by index source host sourcetype | convert ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen) | sort - count
| table _time index sourcetype source host family device actor action_name alert risk_severity marker_value _raw | sort - _time | head 50
